title: agropyron caninum
intro: Agropyron caninum, commonly known as red fescue, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron caninum include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents present in Agropyron caninum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
